title: Placental Risk Assessment to CusTomize Individualized Pregnancy Care and Evaluation
official: Clinical Utility of a Predictive Model of Placental Insufficiency
summary: This is a prospective observational study with the goal of developing and assessing a predictive model of placental insufficiency.

interventions.name: Data Collection Throughout Pregnancy and Delivery

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Age 15 or older
* No known major fetal anatomic or genetic abnormalities
* Singleton gestation
* Planning to deliver at Oregon Health \& Science University
* Prior to 22 weeks' gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Decisional impairment
* Multiple gestation
* Known fetal growth restriction or major congenital anomaly
* Inability to consent
* Inability to attend study visits
